    // The incenter: the point equidistant from all three sides (the center of the
    // inscribed circle), the vertex average weighted by opposite side lengths.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Incenter#Cartesian_coordinates
    Incenter(t: Triangle2D): Point2D
    {
        var a = t.B.Between(t.C).Magnitude;
        var b = t.C.Between(t.A).Magnitude;
        var c = t.A.Between(t.B).Magnitude;
        var sum = a + b + c;
        return ((a * t.A.X + b * t.B.X + c * t.C.X) / sum,
            (a * t.A.Y + b * t.B.Y + c * t.C.Y) / sum);
    }

    //==
    // # Quad2D
    //
    // Handled as a four-vertex ring, so every body is the general polygon kernel
    // applied to `Points`. Precondition (from the declaration): the quad is simple.

    // The four vertices in stored order.
    Points(q: Quad2D): Array<Point2D>
        => [q.A, q.B, q.C, q.D];

    // The absolute shoelace area of the four-vertex ring.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shoelace_formula
    Area(q: Quad2D): Number
        => q.Points.ShoelaceArea.Abs;

    // The sum of the four side lengths.
    Perimeter(q: Quad2D): Number
        => q.Points.ChainLength(true);

    // The area centroid of the quadrilateral — NOT the average of its four
    // vertices, which is a different point for any non-parallelogram.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centroid#Of_a_polygon
    Centroid(q: Quad2D): Point2D
        => q.Points.PolygonAreaCentroid;

    // Even-odd containment over the four-vertex ring.
    Contains(q: Quad2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => q.Points.PolygonContainsPoint(point);

    // The quad with all four vertices carried through the mapping.
    Deform(q: Quad2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): Quad2D
        => (mapping(q.A), mapping(q.B), mapping(q.C), mapping(q.D));

    //==
    // # Parallelogram2D

    // The four corners in ring order: Origin, +SideA, +SideA+SideB, +SideB.
    Corners(g: Parallelogram2D): Array<Point2D>
        => [g.Origin,
            g.Origin + g.SideA,
            g.Origin + g.SideA + g.SideB,
            g.Origin + g.SideB];

    // The magnitude of the cross product of the two side vectors.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parallelogram#Area_formula
    Area(g: Parallelogram2D): Number
        => (g.SideA.X * g.SideB.Y - g.SideA.Y * g.SideB.X).Abs;

    // Twice the sum of the two side lengths.
    Perimeter(g: Parallelogram2D): Number
        => 2.0 * (g.SideA.Magnitude + g.SideB.Magnitude);

    // The intersection of the diagonals: Origin displaced by half of each side.
    Centroid(g: Parallelogram2D): Point2D
        => g.Origin + (g.SideA + g.SideB) * 0.5;

    // The bounds of the four corners.
    Bounds(g: Parallelogram2D): Bounds2D
        => g.Corners.BoundsOfPoints;

    // True when `point` solves (point - Origin) = u*SideA + v*SideB with both u and
    // v in [0, 1]. Solved by Cramer's rule on the 2x2 side matrix; boundary
    // inclusive. Undefined (division by zero) for the degenerate parallel-sides
    // case the declaration excludes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cramer%27s_rule
    Contains(g: Parallelogram2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var w = g.Origin.Between(point);
        var determinant = g.SideA.X * g.SideB.Y - g.SideA.Y * g.SideB.X;
        var u = (w.X * g.SideB.Y - w.Y * g.SideB.X) / determinant;
        var v = (g.SideA.X * w.Y - g.SideA.Y * w.X) / determinant;
        return u >= 0.0 && u <= 1.0 && v >= 0.0 && v <= 1.0;
    }

    // The parallelogram with its corner and both side vectors carried through the
    // mapping. The sides are re-derived as differences of mapped corners, so an
    // affine mapping is reproduced exactly and a non-affine one is approximated by
    // the affine map through those three corners.
    Deform(g: Parallelogram2D, mapping: Function1<Point2D, Point2D>): Parallelogram2D
    {
        var origin = mapping(g.Origin);
        var a = mapping(g.Origin + g.SideA);
        var b = mapping(g.Origin + g.SideB);
        return (origin, origin.Between(a), origin.Between(b));
    }
}
